## Proposal and provenance

Stable algorithm slug: `shape-conditioned-parameter-selection`. Source: pm-4k6b note recorded 2026-07-29T16:59:47.781Z.

Entry slug shape-conditioned-parameter-selection.

The gap. The engine's constants - recency half-life, decay rates, the token budgets, the candidate caps, the sample bounds - were all chosen while looking at one corpus of roughly two thousand items spanning seven months. Roadmap horizon Q records that the product cannot say which of its fitted numbers travel to another population. The instrument to answer it did not exist either: the only synthetic corpus generator varies size and nothing else, so at a million items the fixture is eleven simulated days deep with exactly one history entry per item, against a real mean of 18.7 entries per stream. That is now tracked as its own item.

The mechanism. Make the parameters a function of the corpus's measured shape rather than compiled-in scalars. Measure the population once and cache it - age span and density, history entries per item, hierarchy depth and fan-out distribution, edge-kind mix, annotation volume, author cardinality, arrival rate - then select each constant from that profile through a declared, published rule. A half-life expressed as a fraction of the corpus's observed activity span behaves correctly on a workspace minutes old and on an archive spanning decades, where a fixed number of days is wrong at both ends. A candidate cap expressed as a function of measured branching factor stops sampling three percent of a wide corpus while reading a narrow one exhaustively.

Degeneracy requirement. On a corpus whose measured shape matches this repository's, every selected value must equal the constant it replaces, to the last digit. The proof is a two-part test: exact reproduction on this shape, and a materially different selection on a deliberately different shape, with the difference explained by the rule rather than by tuning.

Why it is an engine entry and not only a governance chore. The inventory of constants and their declared status is governance and is owned elsewhere. What belongs here is the ranking consequence: a scoring function whose parameters are read from the population makes the small-project and multi-decade ends of the spectrum the same code path instead of two special cases, which is what the small-end scale item and the multi-decade readability item both need and neither can get from a fixed constant.

Prerequisites and owners. Shape-capable corpus generation is the instrument. The constants inventory is the input. The relevance contract owns the published rule. Hierarchical shrinkage, already in the catalog, is the natural companion: it supplies calibrated uncertainty for the estimates this entry would condition on, and the two should be designed together rather than sequentially.

Scope clarification from individual-ownership review: pm-sxyj1v owns a related measurement, read primitive or defect fix. It does not independently deliver this proposed ranking behavior. Reuse its evidence and public API; evaluate the additional behavior in this experiment.

## Delivery boundary

Evaluate this mechanism as a bounded public-SDK experiment before any production adoption. Use the existing scorer and packer contracts; no CLI-only behavior or new command noun. The historical catalog is design input, not evidence that this mechanism was implemented.

## Experiment protocol

Freeze a workspace/history revision and parameter manifest. Compare against the current deterministic SDK baseline using held-out judgments and negative controls. Report nDCG/action success, critical-evidence omission, latency p50/p95, peak memory, tokens per completed task, and rebuild cost separately. Include 3-item/minutes, real-shaped, 100k/1M-item, decades-long, and sparse/dense/imbalanced graph scenarios; smoke subsets may not claim scale acceptance. Bound candidate counts, graph expansions, elapsed time, and output size, with cancellation and completeness receipts. Record exact versus approximate behavior and approximation error; theoretical guarantees require their stated assumptions. Missing or untrusted evidence remains unknown, never inferred proof.

Promotion requires a reproducible quality improvement on the held-out target population, no regression of existing exact invariants or mandatory gates, and a declared compute/token cost justified by that improvement. Reject or defer with the same immutable evidence if those conditions fail. No production default, adaptive learning, or data export is authorized by this planning item.
